description: NaCoF₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.58 Å. Co is bonded to six F atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing CoF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are two shorter (2.01 Å) and four longer (2.05 Å) Co-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Co atoms to form distorted FNa₂Co₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent FNa₂Co₂ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent FNa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with six equivalent FNa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the second F site, F is bonded to three equivalent Na and two equivalent Co atoms to form distorted FNa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent FNa₂Co₂ tetrahedra, corners with nine equivalent FNa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three equivalent FNa₂Co₂ tetrahedra, and edges with six equivalent FNa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids.
